note: Regression baseline for the existing tree-sitter languages, captured BEFORE language-expansion / wasm-upgrade work (2026-06-17, commit 0edde30). Re-run `node scripts/_measure.mjs <corpus>/<repo> --lang=<lang> --json` after any change; a DROP in symbols/confident vs these numbers means the change regressed a working language. Tolerance: ±2% is parser noise; larger is a real regression to investigate.
